summary: Innodata Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $300 million of common stock under an equity distribution agreement with multiple sales agents, including Goldman Sachs, Craig-Hallum, Wells Fargo, Maxim Group, and Wedbush. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown via ATM sales on Nasdaq. No special-situation event such as acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is routine capital raising, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
